title: Reduced-motion highlight documented as 'steady' but code draws nothing
detail: PR body, file header, and the function's own doc promise a steady reduced-motion highlight; the early return draws nothing, so reduced-motion users lose the placement feedback entirely.
recommended_fix: When reduced_motion, draw the band at a fixed alpha (skip the k fade) instead of returning.

title: Chip hairline alpha now faded via a line primitive — the rlsw trap the diff itself documents
evidence:
// the paper chip + ink hairline (full-alpha — the rlsw line-alpha trap)
 	out := v.palette.ink_soft
-	out.a = 255
+	out.a = u8(255 * fade)
-	rl.DrawRectangleLinesEx({x0, y0, cw, ch}, max(1.0, s * 0.02), out)
+	rl.DrawRectangleLinesEx({x0, y0, cw, ch}, max(1.0, s * 0.02 * reveal_scale), out)
+// (the rlsw line-alpha trap: a translucent DrawLineEx would capture solid —
detail: The diff itself states rlsw ignores line alpha, so DrawRectangleLinesEx captures solid ink while the GPU app fades it — reveal frames diverge between harness and live app.
recommended_fix: Keep the hairline at full alpha during reveal, or replace it with thin filled quads whose alpha fades (fills blend in rlsw).

title: run_destroy on temp-allocator shadow clone repeats the bad-free pattern this PR removes
evidence:
+	shadow := shadow_clone(state, context.temp_allocator)
+	defer pp.run_destroy(&shadow)
+	// TEMP allocator — the `defer delete`s were invalid frees (the temp arena
+	// owns the memory; 134 `+++ bad free` lines per `odin test core` run, the
detail: The PR removes temp-arena deletes as invalid frees, then run_destroy frees dozens of temp-cloned shadow arrays per predict (and catalogs_destroy on temp-loaded catalogs) — same bad-free pattern.
recommended_fix: Clone shadows with context.allocator before run_destroy, or add a destroy path that skips temp-backed arrays; verify app/render bad-free output.

title: ordered_remove called without a core:containers import in the new file
detail: ordered_remove comes from core:containers; the new file imports only core, raylib, and core:mem. Unless the pinned compiler exposes it as a builtin, this cannot compile.

title: Demo capture comments misstate the reveal envelope math
evidence:
+#   4100 ms (t82)  — reveal mid-envelope (scale ~0.75, fade ~0.8)
+#   4250 ms (t85)  — reveal tail (the node ~settled, highlight fading)
+		k := f32(tick - r.spawn_tick) / f32(SPAWN_REVEAL_TICKS)
+		e := smoothstep01(k)
+		return 0.4 + 0.6 * e, 0.3 + 0.7 * e, true
detail: At t82 (age 2/8) smoothstep01(0.25)=0.156 gives scale 0.49/fade 0.41, not ~0.75/~0.8; and the t85 highlight is already expired (ends T+4), not 'fading'.
recommended_fix: Recompute the capture comments from the envelope (true mid ≈ t84) or move the 4100ms capture to t84.

title: spawn_fx_init / spawn_fx_destroy are never called anywhere in the diff
detail: App, harness, and tests only ever call spawn_fx_reset on zero-value Spawn_FX; init and destroy have no call sites, so the intended allocator/capacity path is dead.
recommended_fix: Wire spawn_fx_init/spawn_fx_destroy into the View lifecycle, or delete both procs.

title: Unreachable dedup-reset branch in spawn_fx_predict
detail: predicted_window is only ever assigned when lead ≤ 10, and lead decreases monotonically toward a fixed window, so predicted_window == window is unreachable inside the lead > 10 branch.
recommended_fix: Delete the reset; the dedup's window comparison already forces re-prediction once the window advances.

title: Negative-leg comment misstates separation distance (1 tile, not 2)
detail: The bad place (13,10) is 1 tile from the fixture router at (12,10), not 2. The rejection still holds (1 < 4) but the stated distance is wrong.
recommended_fix: Correct the comment to '1 tile', or move the bad place to a true 2-tile offset.

title: `_ = before` edit residue in the feed test
evidence:
+	before := len(s.events) - 1 // the last event is the t80 NODE_SPAWNED
+	_ = before
+	slice := s.events[before:]
detail: `before` is used in the slice expression two lines below; the explicit discard is edit residue that wrongly signals an unused variable.

title: Telegraph timeline subtracts u64 T - SPAWN_LEAD_TICKS without a guard
detail: spawn_tick is data-driven via terminal_spawn_interval_ticks; a window landing before tick 10 makes T - 10 wrap u64, so the guard always returns and no ring renders.
recommended_fix: Compare in i64 (i64(tick) < i64(T) - SPAWN_LEAD_TICKS) so early windows draw instead of wrapping.

title: Test fixture omits the claimed demo recipe's second draw (0→1)
evidence:
+// sfx_fixture — the growth.dem recipe's seed topology: the residential ←

detail: The demo recipe also draws 0→1 at t50 and times edits at t40/t50; the fixture applies only 1→3 at init, so test spawn positions differ from the goldens'.
